# `FluxRuntimeHost::submit_overlay_frame`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Submits one complete RGBA8 overlay frame for the active plugin overlay.

## Signature

```rust
fn submit_overlay_frame (& mut self , width : u32 , height : u32 , rgba8 : & [u8] ,) -> Result < () , FluxStatus >
```

| `height` | u32 | `height` argument passed as `u32`. |
| `rgba8` | & [u8] | `rgba8` argument passed as `& [u8]`. |

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxruntimehost-submit-overlay-frame.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxruntimehost-submit-overlay-frame.md)_

```rust
fn send_overlay(host: &mut FluxRuntimeHost) -> FluxStatus {
    let rgba8 = vec![
        255, 64, 64, 128, 64, 64, 255, 128,
        64, 255, 64, 128, 255, 255, 64, 128,
    ];
    match host.submit_overlay_frame(2, 2, &rgba8) {
        Ok(()) => FluxStatus::OK,
        Err(status) => status,
    }
}
```
